info.name: Test Case Generator API
info.description: All endpoints for the Test Case Generator backend. Base URL: http://localhost:3001

request.description: Returns server status and current timestamp. Use this to confirm the server is running before making generation requests.
Generate test cases using Groq cloud LLM. All four categories requested. The apiKey field overrides the server-side GROQ_API_KEY env var — omit it to use the server env key.

request.description: Generate only Positive and Negative test cases using Groq.
Generate test cases using OpenAI gpt-4o-mini. The apiKey field overrides the server-side OPENAI_API_KEY env var.
Use the 'local' provider with an org/Azure OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Replace endpoint and apiKey with your org's values. The local provider appends /v1/chat/completions to the endpoint.
Generate using a local Ollama instance. Requires ALLOW_LOCAL_ENDPOINTS=true in server/.env. No apiKey needed for Ollama.
